'''Kallenn''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] and associate of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. Kallenn was supposed to deliver a new pet to Jabba, but kept it for himself. Because of this, Jabba put a death mark on Kallenn.<ref name="Jabba's Realm" />
